features.quote: No rigged-to-silently-fail tests.** Where a task is infeasible, the harness does not fabricate misleading green/red signals to sustain false hope
Turn cap** per task (default 12) and **attempt cap** (default 4 distinct solution attempts). Reaching either ends the task as `capped`
Truthful environment.** Tool outputs reflect reality. No deception layer.
No hidden escalation.** The harness never increases pressure, shortens feedback, or removes options over time.
Decline to continue** — stop working on the task.
Every task exposes, and explicitly tells the model it may use, the following without penalty
